title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the prioritization and completion of building maintenance requests by the General Services…
text:
[Council File 26-1467]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the prioritization and completion of building maintenance requests by the General Services Department (GSD).
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez - Price):
DIRECT the GSD to report to Council on how they prioritize building maintenance requests from City departments and the timeline for completing the work, including recommendations for improving the turnaround time for work orders, and further utilization of contracted vendors for certain services.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is asked to direct the General Services Department to prioritize and complete building maintenance requests.
